headline: Two teams climb into the ARC-2 top 100

sections.text: Something AI Related climbed 404 places, from 502nd to 98th, reaching 33.47 after a 2.08-point gain.
T0m0t0m0 W climbed from 232nd to 97th at 33.47, a 1.25-point gain. Both teams are now inside the top 100 on the public board.
